headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / Times of India / Munsif Daily
bullets_en: Revanth Reddy sets target of 90 Assembly seats, backs Rahul Gandhi for PM.
2 Army soldiers killed after tank runs over them during training exercise in Haryana.
FSSAI orders prosecution of Bisleri over ‘unsafe’ packaged water.
Countdown has begun for Congress, KCR’s return inevitable: KTR.
bullets_ur: Revanth Reddy ne 90 Assembly seats ka hadaf rakh diya, Rahul Gandhi ki PM ke liye himayat ki.
Haryana mein training exercise ke doran tank chalne se 2 Army soldiers jaan se gaye.
FSSAI ne 'unsafe' packaged water par Bisleri ke khilaf chalane ka hukum de diya.
Congress ke liye countdown shuru ho chuka hai, KCR ki wapsi tay hai: KTR.
